name: Municipal Corporation Sonipat
headquarters: Municipal Corporation, Railway Road, opposite PWD Rest House, Sonipat, Haryana
description: Civic archive for Municipal Corporation Sonipat, a Haryana NCR corporation constituted in 2015. The current 22 wards are set out in Haryana final delimitation order 6/58/2025-4CI dated 26 December 2025 and were used in the 10 May 2026 election. The 27 December 2020 election used 20 wards. The KMP Expressway connects the Sonipat area with Manesar, and the Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor project is planned to link them by rail.
